claims: D4 (a): U1 omits the documents issue only when the composed root declares at least one include and nothing of its own in any section; every other unattended model keeps U1 exactly as before.
VG4-C1 and C3: a seeded root's first round declares its first document and adds owned elements and an attached constraint; preview, apply and finalize exit 0 and the result validates.
D6: repin-include on an unattended root is refused under every policy, before the policy runs; a root without the mode is answered as before.
R0.6: an operation that modifies, renames or deletes an included element is refused.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch this change adds handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
